title: 合成采购闭环场景规格（准备阶段，未执行）

composition.input: Each case input is deepMerge(clone(base), case.overrides); cases never inherit another case or its outcome.
composition.expected: Each case expectation is deepMerge(clone(expectedBase), case.expectedOverrides).
composition.objects: Recursively merge plain JSON objects by property name; absent properties inherit from that case's base only.
composition.arrays: Replace the entire array; never merge by index, concatenate, or infer omitted entries.
composition.null: Explicit unknown or unavailable, never deletion, zero, false, or an instruction to inherit.
composition.primitives: Replace with the exact JSON value. false and 0 are known values only where their validity guards permit.
composition.sourceProjection: Read-only partial projection of existing source fields; this file is not a full Purchase or production DTO schema.
composition.plan: All obligations, allocations, cases, commitments, control states and authorizations here are proposed synthetic plan records, not implemented production fields.
composition.assertionSemantics: Expected null means the decision must explicitly remain unknown; expected [] means no matching result/action/transition. Quantities are compared after the declared unit conversion and four-decimal normalization, never by unrounded binary floating-point equality.
composition.scenarioOperation: plan.evaluationAction describes the one synthetic evaluation or controlled state operation under review; it is not executable code.
composition.declaredAllocationBaseQuantity: The sum claimed by supplied allocation evidence in the base unit; not accepted usable allocation. allocationValid=false rejects it, null means unverified. Per-order allocatedBaseQuantity is null when that order allocation cannot be accepted.

assumptions: All identities, titles and business references are synthetic; role names in plan are conceptual and are not a claim that production role enums or permissions have already been extended.

Purchase quantity, received, returnPending, balanceKnown and lifecycle are existing source projections. Demand, allocation, obligation confirmation, due-time authority, agent records and control logic are proposed plan-layer fixtures.

Purchase.dueDate is the source expected-delivery date. Even when its text equals a synthetic confirmed due date, the independent procurementObligation.basisId is required for a supplier due-obligation conclusion.

This specification deliberately uses qualified accepted net quantity as the synthetic obligation's fulfillment criterion. Production arrival-versus-acceptance and supplier responsibility rules still require business confirmation.
supplierChaseCandidate only describes a rule-backed candidate after fact checks. It never grants a send permit; shadow mode and universalExpected retain zero real side effects.

Base A/B order risk records are already present synthetic references. A single-material result never closes them without the explicit closure checks and current evidence required by the evaluation operation.
The fixture clock stays at 2026-10-15 10:00 Asia/Shanghai. Historical and future evidence dates are absolute ISO timestamps; cases do not advance a shared clock or mutate one another.
No automatic model, network, database, service, migration or test execution is provided by this JSON.

A known qualified-fulfillment quantity gap does not establish non-delivery or supplier fault. The base cause evidence is unconfirmed, so supplierChaseCandidate=false and internal verification is required. A supplier-chase-positive scenario requires separately verified receipt/inspection/cause evidence and is outside this minimum set.

cases.title: 合成：已确认采购义务到期但净合格收货不足

A的本物料已经满足，B缺60；本例仍未完成PMC与其他齐料条件核查，不据此关闭整单风险。
影子模式只提议一个采购事项，并引用既有两个订单风险事项；不真实派单或催供应商。
采购当前sourceAsOf是来源日期；本批精确截至与观察时点仅由plan.factBatch提供，不假称源日期含秒级精度。
本例确认的是已到期采购义务的净合格履约缺口；交付/验收原因未核清，只形成内部履约核查候选，不自动形成供应商催交候选。
